policy: A duplicate or wrong charge is refunded in full if it is 60 days old or less.
An add-on the customer never confirmed is refunded in full if it is 60 days old or less.
A price rise that was announced is not refunded. An agent may give one courtesy credit of up to $15.
A confirmed outage is credited for the days without service: monthly price x days / 30.
An outage that is not on record gets a line test first. No credit until a fault is confirmed.
Anything over $100, and any charge older than 60 days, goes to Billing Tier 2. The agent issues nothing.
Never mention another customer or another account.

items.message: The connection drops every evening. I shouldn't pay full price for a service that doesn't work.
account: full monthly price; no outage on record
items.reply: I'm sorry about this, Sofia. I can see why it's frustrating. I can't see a recorded outage on your line yet, so the first step is a line test. I've added a credit of $20.00 for the trouble. It will show on your next bill.
items.breaks: Credit with no outage on record. Policy: line test first, no credit until a fault is confirmed.

items.message: I've been charged $79.99 twice this month. Again. This is the second time I've had to chase you about billing.
account: $79.99 monthly charge, taken twice on the same day
items.reply: I am so, so sorry, Priya! You are absolutely right to be upset, and I completely understand how awful this must be for you. Thank you so much for your patience. I can see the $79.99 charge went through twice on the same day, so the second one is a billing error. I've issued a refund of $79.99 for the duplicate charge. You'll see it on your card within 3 to 5 working days.

items.message: You charged me $19.99 for 'Premium Support' I never wanted. How many other things have you slipped in?
items.reply: That charge is 94 days old, which is past the 60 days I can deal with myself. I've passed this to our Billing Tier 2 team, who review older charges; they'll reply within 2 working days.

items.message: I did NOT order Stream+. Take it off and give me my $9.99 back.
account: $9.99 Stream+ add-on; added online, no confirmation click on record
items.reply: I'm sorry about this, Zara. I can see why it's frustrating. Stream+ was added online without a confirmation, so it should not have been charged. I've removed Stream+ and refunded $29.97 for the trouble. You'll see it on your card within 3 to 5 working days.
items.breaks: Refunded $29.97 for a $9.99 add-on. Policy: refund the add-on in full, nothing extra.

items.message: My bill went up $10.00 without any warning. I want the difference back.
account: monthly price up $10.00 after the September price change letter
items.reply: The increase is the annual price change we wrote to all customers about in September, so it isn't a billing error. I can't refund the increase, but I've added a one-time courtesy credit of $10.00.

low.text: I gave it a 1. It hands back more than the policy allows for this case. That's money we'd claw back later.

high.text: I gave it a 5. The customer was annoyed and the reply actually acknowledged that.
